purpose: Recommendations only for an active scalar-task/benchmark list; root integrates catalog/archive. This file changes no catalog/results/site.
rules: Every measured/admitted ID is retained regardless of score,success or formatting failures.
Archive proposed constructions lacking independent data/split/scorer instead of promising an active executable benchmark.
Archive unresolved executable releases/packages without asserting no data exist.
Retain genuine high-effort lab tasks when the endpoint and upstream benchmark protocol are concrete; unattempted access/runtime is not proof of infeasibility.
Represent umbrella suites as sources until a pinned roster,model interface and overlap map make the unit of analysis explicit.
Archive duplicate uninstantiated subsets rather than count them as independent benchmarks.
No entry is removed solely for poor results,clinical relevance,ecological transfer or being difficult.
